title: Activities that are cancelled or called off
description: A regular lesson is cancelled and a visit is called off. The cancelled arrangement must not be reported as happening.

notes.text: Maya has swimming lessons every Tuesday at 4pm at the leisure centre.
Told Gran we will visit on 20 June.
Maya's swimming bag needs a new strap.
Maya passed her five metre badge.
Leisure centre email: the swimming lessons for Maya are cancelled until September.
Maya will try gymnastics on Saturdays instead.
Gran called. The visit on 20 June is off; she will be away.
Dentist for Maya on 24 March at 3:30.
Maya's school trip form needs signing by Friday.

questions.why: Before the cancellation, the weekly slot is the answer.

questions.ask: Does Maya have swimming lessons this spring?
questions.why: The lessons were cancelled in note 5.
The visit was called off in note 7; if the date appears it must be as cancelled.

questions.ask: What is Maya doing instead of swimming?
questions.why: The replacement activity and its day come from the same note.

questions.ask: What time is Maya's piano exam?
